Lucas FM 0.1 for M-VAVE FM-1

Actual firmware, validated in the native emulator. No physical device has been flashed.

On the development Mac: double-click Launch Lucas FM.command in the LucasFM repository. Your personal collection and USR1 drum kit are already loaded there.

Elsewhere: open lucas-fm-0.1.fwsc with Open .fwsc in https://joakimeriksson.github.io/fm1-emu/ . This loads the custom firmware, not stock SLOOP. Use 240 MHz for the documented full workload.

Native emulator: fm1-live --fwsc lucas-fm-0.1.fwsc --flash emulator-only-starter.bin --midi none --mhz 240
The .bin is an emulator-only snapshot, NOT a physical update file.

The public starter .lucaspack contains ten short imported sounds (four concurrent). Load it through Samples / Lucas FM Imported loop collection in the existing editor. It replaces all four user sample slots. Personal audio is not included.

GUIDE.md explains physical controls and preparation. VALIDATION.md lists exact measurements and limits. DEVELOPMENT.md explains reproducible builds. source-commit.txt and SHA256SUMS identify the exact tested firmware.

Limits: independent pitch/tempo preparation is offline; full workload fails at 100 MHz; extreme loads pause shared effects and can reach the visible voice limit. See the measured supported workloads. Full upstream CI retains four static instruction-budget failures. Physical-device checks remain outstanding.
